excerpt: Mantle Chat is a team chat app where teammates and AI models or agents work in the same channels: @mention GPT, Claude or Gemini, build shared agents, schedule tasks and connect tools. Free for up to 10 members; paid from $10 per member a month billed yearly. Pricing and alternatives.
content:
Mantle Chat is a team messaging platform with AI built into the conversation. Teams work in Slack- or Discord-style channels, DMs and threads, and can @mention an AI model such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok or DeepSeek, or a custom agent, in the middle of a discussion so everyone sees the answer. Agents can be built and shared across the team, trained on a shared knowledge base of documents, PDFs, images, code and CSV files, and connected to tools like Notion, Linear and Gmail. Tasks can run on a schedule or a trigger, and the app also has canvases, voice and video calls and screen sharing.

In a channel, an agent works with the shared channel history; turning a message into a thread gives it a separate context, so several agents can work in parallel. The founders said on Product Hunt that tools run with the credentials of the person who invoked the agent, or of whoever created a scheduled task. Separate workspaces keep projects or departments apart. Paid plans give access to 28 hosted models and differ mainly in AI credits per member.

Mantle Chat was co-founded by Katja Danilina and Ilia Barchugov. It launched on Product Hunt on 19 May 2026 and finished #4 for the day with 312 upvotes and 41 comments.

We have not tested Mantle Chat ourselves. This page brings together Mantle Chat's website, pricing, about and contact pages, its Product Hunt page and launch discussion, and says where each fact comes from.

paragraphs: Katja Danilina says the team built Mantle Chat because AI at work should feel collaborative rather than isolated. Talking to teams, they found people already used AI, but alone: messaging in Slack or Teams, AI in separate private chats, and a lot of copying in between.

Mantle Chat brings both into one workspace so the whole team can learn and work with AI together, with models and agents in shared channels, tasks that run on their own, and integrations with the tools teams already use.
launch_story.attribution: Katja Danilina, co-founder, on Product Hunt

use_cases: Asking an AI model a question in a team channel so everyone sees the answer
Building shared agents that use the team's documents and connected tools
Scheduling agents, such as a daily summary of a Linear backlog
Keeping project or department knowledge separate in its own workspace

fit: are a small team that wants chat and AI in one place instead of Slack plus separate AI apps
want to use several AI models without separate subscriptions
want prompts and AI answers visible to the whole team
not_fit: rely on HubSpot or Zendesk integrations: the founder said these were planned, not available
need versioning of AI-assisted decisions: the founder said replays exist but versioning does not
are a large company tied to Slack or Teams

pricing.intro: Mantle Chat has a free plan and per-member paid plans that differ mainly in AI credits. Prices are in US dollars, billed annually, from Mantle Chat's pricing page; annual billing saves 15% over monthly.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 1,500 AI credits a month, efficient models, up to 10 members, 3 workspaces, 2 shared agents, 1 integration, 90-day history

plans.name: Core
plans.detail: 10,000 credits, all 28 hosted models and web search, scheduled tasks, 3 integrations, unlimited history; 14-day trial

notes: When credits run out, AI pauses but the workspace keeps working; 10,000 extra credits cost $12. Mantle says it never bills overage silently.
Enterprise plans add contracted usage, SCIM and audit logs.

alternatives.intro: Product Hunt lists Runbear, Sim and Kollab among Mantle Chat's alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own; check each tool's pricing page for current prices.

items.name: Runbear
items.what: AI teammates that automate workflows inside Slack and Teams
items.difference: Adds agents to Slack or Teams; Mantle Chat replaces the chat app itself.

items.name: Sim
items.what: Open-source workspace for AI agents and workflows
items.difference: Workflow builder for agents, without team messaging at the centre.

items.name: Kollab
items.what: Shared workspace where teams work with agents
items.difference: A similar team-plus-agents workspace; compare integrations and pricing.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Claude and Velozity.

liked: @mentioning AI in the same channel as teammates
Shared AI context instead of isolated prompts
asked: How agents in the same channel keep context apart (threads have separate context)
Whose credentials shared agents use (the invoking user, or the creator for scheduled tasks)
Whether context persists across sessions (yes, via workspace and agent knowledge bases)
Whether HubSpot and Zendesk are coming (planned)
criticised: No versioning of how AI-assisted decisions were reached

quotes.text: Love the "@ the model in the same channel as your teammates" framing, that's the part Slack-with-a-bot-bolted-on always got wrong.
quotes.author: Mahdi Nouri

quotes.text: when everyone's prompting Claude or GPT separately, institutional knowledge just evaporates.
quotes.author: Ansari Adin

quotes.text: Do you have any versioning or replay for how an AI-assisted decision was reached in a shared channel?
quotes.author: Dhiraj Patel

pros: Chat and many AI models in one shared workspace
Free plan for up to 10 members
Clear credit system with no silent overage billing
Per-user credentials for agents using connected tools
cons: Integrations are limited per person on lower plans (1 on Free, 3 on Core)
HubSpot and Zendesk integrations were not available at launch
Switching team chat apps is a big change for established teams
Free plan keeps only 90 days of history

faq.a: A team messaging app where teammates, AI models and shared AI agents work together in the same channels, with scheduled tasks, a knowledge base and tool integrations.
Yes, for up to 10 members with 1,500 AI credits a month and a selected set of models. Paid plans start at $10 per member a month billed yearly.

faq.q: Which AI models can I use?
faq.a: Paid plans include all 28 hosted models, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek; the free plan includes six.

faq.q: What happens when credits run out?
faq.a: AI pauses while the workspace keeps working. You can upgrade or buy 10,000 credits for $12.
Product Hunt lists Claude, Sim, Velozity, Runbear and Kollab.
